subtopics.title: Setting Up Python Environment
subtopics.description: Learn how to install Python and set up a basic development environment. Understand the importance of a consistent environment for reproducible results and error isolation.

subtopics.title: Creating a Django Project
subtopics.description: Discover the process of creating a Django project from scratch. Explore the command-line interface and the structure of a Django project, including settings, URLs, and WSGI files. Understand the role of each component in a Django project.
